name: 04-files
teaches: fs/read, fs/write, fs/list and fs/remove against one granted directory, and the four things a scope constrains: access, max_bytes, the .. escape, and an absolute path.
cmd: echo '$ drt run --config readwrite.json'; drt run --config readwrite.json; echo; echo '$ drt run --config read-only.json'; drt run --config read-only.json
